• Managed daily reconciliation of Profits and Losses (P&L), Mark-to-Market (MTM), and positions for Treasury and 
Investment businesses, reconciling with the General Ledger (GL) and assisting Finance during month-end closing 
• Reconciled actual vs. estimated P&L and prepared flash and actual variance analyses for Fixed Income and Equity 
products.
